task3.description: Packing canonicalization under Gamma (192 maps: S4 x Z2 x Z2 x Z2)
task3.note: Measures literal witness shapes under this specific group action. Not a claim about minimum structural templates. IMPORTANT: 'packing_orbits'/'sx_orbits' are MINIMUM LITERAL-SHAPE CLASS COUNTS of the 1144 saved records; '*_orbit_sizes' histograms are CATALOGUE CLASS FREQUENCIES (records sharing one canonical shape), NOT group-orbit cardinalities. A true Gamma orbit size divides |Gamma|=192; these frequencies need not (e.g. 176). No symmetry/stabilizer interpretation.
